advertised: 60+ (root package.json description, upstream/ruflo-v3.37.0/package.json:9 and the published ruflo tarball package.json:3)
conflicts.verified: 89 agent definition files (81 unique frontmatter names) ship in the @claude-flow/cli tarball; 1 more ships inside the single packaged plugin. The manifest figure 164 is reproducible as `git ls-files '.claude/agents/*.md' 'plugins/*/agents/*.md'` at the REPO ROOT (108 + 56) — a set that is NOT what the tarball carrying that manifest contains.

356 tools are registered by registerTools() in the published dist/src/mcp-client.js:118-175. 397 is reproducible but wrong: generate-catalog-manifest.mjs:41-50 counts every `name: '...'` string literal in src/mcp-tools/*.ts, which sweeps in 39 non-tool literals (JSON-schema property values, hook event names) and misses the 3 real tools defined in src/ruvector/coverage-tools.ts.

advertised: 60+ commands (README.md:57 — refers to slash commands, not CLI verbs)
conflicts.verified: 53 top-level CLI commands, all packaged. Neither 26 nor 60+ matches. 167 Claude Code slash-command .md files ship under .claude/commands/, which is the closest thing to '60+ commands' and is itself 2.8x that figure.

38 plugin directories exist in the repo; the marketplace manifest lists 35 of them (omits ruflo-agntcy, ruflo-bbs-federation, ruflo-graph-intelligence... precisely: ruflo-agntcy, ruflo-bbs-federation, ruflo-business-pods). Exactly ONE plugin (ruflo-metaharness) is present in the published @claude-flow/cli tarball; the other 37 are not shipped by the package that `npm i ruflo` installs.

34 skill directories are packaged; 33 contain a SKILL.md. The directory `.claude/skills/dual-mode` ships three .md files (dual-collect.md, dual-coordinate.md, dual-spawn.md) and a README.md but no SKILL.md, so it is not a loadable skill. catalog-manifest's 34 counts directories, not loadable skills.

The repo-root .claude/settings.json IS valid. `ruflo init` generates settings programmatically (dist/src/init/settings-generator.js), so whether this file is ever parsed at runtime is a REACHABLE question this lane cannot answer.

Whether the upward walk reaches agentdb installs outside the dependency subtree is a REACHABLE question this lane cannot answer.
